The '''Hunchback construction strider''' was a model of [[Walker/Legends|walker]] produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its design was similar to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PT]]. However it carried no weapon as its purpose was construction and civil engineering work.<ref name="Far Horizons" />
